world_model_delta: Each completed chain step produces a CHAIN_STEP_TOKEN: {chain_id, step_number, faction, turn_completed, resource_bonus}. Tokens accumulate until chain completion, then are consumed to generate the CHAIN_ARTIFACT. Tokens have no governance meaning.
validator_question: Do CHAIN_STEP_TOKENs persist after chain completion?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — intermediate state token, no governance claim
